title: versu!
tagline: Hardware-verified rhythm game on chain. Pay 1 USDC for 3 games. Entry fees fund the prize pool.
description: versu! is a browser rhythm game with a verifiable Sui leaderboard. Players buy three ranked plays for 1 USDC. A trustable bridge hardware signs gameplay inputs, and a custom GKR proof verifies scores on-chain (Sui). World ID prevents duplicate prize claims; smart contracts split the daily prize pool among the top five.
how_its_made: We built the game with React and PixiJS, using Mysten’s Sui SDK and WalletConnect for payments. BridgeOS (which belongs to the bridge hardware) records and signs USB HID inputs. a Rust prover generates a custom GKR/sumcheck score proof, which Sui Move verifies before recording a score. Sui contracts hold USDC and distribute prizes, while World ID prevent duplicate prize claims. The unusual part is binding a hardware-signed input trace to a proof Sui can verify. The current keys and proof setup are for a demo.
auto_summary: A browser rhythm game ties paid Sui leaderboard entries to hardware-signed input traces and on-chain score-proof verification.
